item.title: GO in vaccines / 5G activation claims
item.description:
Evidence: Fringe

Recycled claims that COVID vaccines contain graphene oxide and/or that GO can be “activated” by 5G. Mid-September 2026 posts repeated 2021-era microscopy and petition-hearing material.

Why Fringe

  • Licensed vaccine ingredient lists (FDA, EMA, MHRA and manufacturers) do not include graphene oxide.
  • GO has been used in lab imaging (e.g. cryo-EM) of spike protein — that is not a formulation ingredient.
  • Viral “self-assembly” clips have been traced by fact-checkers to a pre-COVID high-voltage physics demonstration.

See [[weekly/2026-W38]] and [[recurrence/log]].

Evidence: Well-supported for the Nature trilayer paper and for regulator ingredient lists. Fringe for covert-ingredient claims.

Twist

Cao, Park, Watanabe, Taniguchi, Jarillo-Herrero, Nature 595, 526 (2021). Magic-angle twisted trilayer graphene: superconductivity in in-plane fields >10 T, about 2–3× the conventional Pauli limit in that report; re-entrant SC at high field over a narrower density/displacement window. Not predicted from strong spin–orbit. Still three sheets in a fridge. arXiv 2103.12083 (22 Mar); journal 21 Jul.

item.title: Conspiracy and fringe-narrative log
item.description:
Not a truth list. Documenting a start date is not endorsing the claim.

Two different problems live on this tab:

  1. Fringe — a conspiracy-style narrative (plot, hidden ingredient, activation, cover-up).
  2. Unsourced — a factual-sounding claim with no solid primary source. It may be ordinary hype, a rumor, or a press sentence that cannot be opened. It is not automatically a conspiracy.

Theories and companies stay elsewhere: [[logs/theories]] · [[logs/companies]].

Fringe narratives

When the narrative takes form Claim Label Notes Pages
2021 era (pandemic microscopy / petition circuit) Licensed COVID vaccines contain graphene oxide Fringe Ingredient lists (FDA, EMA, MHRA, manufacturers) do not include GO. GO used in some lab imaging of spike is not a formulation ingredient. [[topics/fringe/2026-09-16-go-vaccine-5g-claims]] · [[fringe/log]]
Same cluster, viral video GO “self-assembles” or is “activated” by 5G / emergency alerts Fringe Common clip traced by fact-checkers to a pre-COVID high-voltage physics demo (Stanford Complexity Group era), not vaccines. [[topics/fringe/2026-09-16-go-vaccine-5g-claims]] · [[recurrence/log]]
Recurs whenever GO toxicity papers trend “GO is in the water / air / shots because papers exist on GO toxicity” Fringe overlay Nanosafety papers can be real; they do not prove covert deployment. [[weekly/2026-W38]] · [[reference/safety]]

Experimental GO as an animal-model adjuvant is a real research topic. Do not file it as a conspiracy, and do not file it as proof about licensed human vaccines.

item.title: Poison or pencil lead
item.description:
Parent: [[topics/fringe]]. Health numbers: [[topics/health/effects]]. Forms: [[reference/forms]].

The two slogans

“Graphene is poison.” Treats GO, dry nanoplatelet powder, and a peeled monolayer as one object. Ignores the short human GO inhalation study (Andrews 2024 / NCT03659864) and the absence of a worker case series in the reviews NIOSH used. Also ignores that high-dose rodent lung work is real — just not a license to use the word “poison” for every sheet.

item.title: Spray and weather
item.description:
Parent: [[topics/fringe]]. Label on this column is Fringe unless a primary says otherwise.

What circulates

  • Aircraft contrails recast as “chemtrails” that contain graphene or GO.
  • Weather-control or solar-geoengineering programmes said to spray graphene as the payload.
  • The same payload then tied to 5G, vaccines, or livestock deaths in one thread.

What the public record actually holds

  • Graphene-family powders are made in plants and labs. That is [[topics/manufacturing/directory]].
  • Occupational air samples exist at some of those plants. That is [[topics/health/effects]] (NIOSH field notes).
  • There is no regulator text on this shelf that treats graphene as an authorized aerial-spray climate tool.
  • A toxicity paper in rodents is not a flight log. [[reference/safety]]

Why it stays on Fringe

The jump is always the same: a real material + a real high-dose paper + a photograph of a sky → a programme. The middle step is missing. Missing citation = [[logs/unsourced]]. A cover-up story = this column.
